structure.prompt: A national bank's mortgage applications are down 20%. Why?
structure.buckets: Market (rates, house prices) · Our pricing vs rivals · Channel (brokers, online) · Approval process

structure.prompt: Should a hotel group launch a budget brand?
structure.buckets: Market attractiveness · Cannibalisation of current hotels · Economics per hotel · Capabilities & brand risk

structure.prompt: A hospital's emergency waiting times have doubled.
structure.buckets: Demand (volume, case mix) · Capacity (staff, beds) · Process (triage, handovers) · Outflow (beds upstairs)

structure.prompt: How should a newspaper grow digital subscriptions?
structure.buckets: Reach (traffic, new audiences) · Convert free → paid (paywall, price) · Retain (engagement, bundles) · Revenue per subscriber (tiers, add-ons)

structure.prompt: Should a car maker build its own battery plant?
structure.buckets: Demand & security of supply · Make vs buy economics · Technology risk · Partners/JV

structure.prompt: A fashion retailer's online returns cost too much.
structure.buckets: Return rate by product/size · Cost per return · Root causes (fit, photos) · Policy levers

structure.prompt: Should a city introduce a congestion charge?
structure.buckets: Objectives (traffic, pollution, revenue) · Impact on residents & businesses · Alternatives · Implementation

structure.prompt: How would you value a football club?
structure.buckets: Revenue streams (media, match-day, commercial) · Costs (wages) · Multiples of comparable deals · Strategic premium

structure.prompt: A pharma company's new drug is selling below forecast.
structure.buckets: Doctors (awareness, prescribing) · Patients (access, price) · Payers (reimbursement) · Competition

structure.prompt: Should an airline start a loyalty credit card?
structure.buckets: Customer value · Economics (bank payments per point) · Partner choice · Brand risk

structure.prompt: A ski resort's profits fell after two warm winters.
structure.buckets: Revenue (visitors × spend, by season) · Costs (fixed vs flexible) · Snow risk (snowmaking, altitude) · Other income (summer, events)

structure.prompt: How can a university increase international students?
structure.buckets: Markets & demand · Offer (courses, price, rankings) · Visas & policy · Recruitment channels

structure.prompt: A food-delivery start-up is burning cash. What do you cut?
structure.buckets: Unit economics per order · Fixed costs · Marketing efficiency (CAC) · City-by-city profitability

structure.prompt: Should a supermarket open dark stores for 15-min delivery?
structure.buckets: Demand density · Economics per order · Cannibalisation · Operations & competition

structure.prompt: A government wants more women in the workforce.
structure.buckets: Barriers (childcare, flexibility, norms) · Employers · Policy levers · Measurement

structure.prompt: How should an electricity company prepare for rooftop solar?
structure.buckets: Lost demand · Grid costs · New services (batteries, EV) · Pricing & regulation

structure.prompt: A cinema chain's attendance has not recovered.
structure.buckets: Content supply · Customer experience & price · Streaming substitution · Alternative uses of space

structure.prompt: Should a coffee brand sell in supermarkets?
structure.buckets: Brand risk · Incremental revenue vs cannibalisation of cafés · Retailer economics · Operations

structure.prompt: A logistics company's on-time delivery fell to 85%.
structure.buckets: Where in the chain (pickup, hub, last mile) · Capacity vs volume · Process and systems · External factors (weather, partners)

structure.prompt: How would you increase organ donor registrations?
structure.buckets: Awareness · Ease of sign-up (opt-out vs opt-in) · Trust · Channels (licences, GPs)
